datasets.name: macro_time_series
queryLines:
SELECT
  Date,
  BANKNIFTY_Close,
  EXP(log_Brent_USD_bbl) as Brent_USD_bbl,
  EXP(log_USDINR) as USDINR,
  India_Real_GDP_YoY_Pct,
  India_Bank_Credit_Growth_YoY_Pct,
  EXP(log_India_System_Liquidity_INR_Trn) as India_System_Liquidity_INR_Trn,
  India_Real_Rate,
  India_Term_Spread,
  India_Rate_Differential
FROM
  workspace.banknifty_macro.gold_macro_features
ORDER BY
  Date

datasets.name: banking_metrics_time_series
queryLines:
SELECT
  Date,
  India_Bank_Deposit_Growth_YoY_Pct,
  India_CASA_Ratio_Pct,
  India_GNPA_Ratio_Pct,
  India_NNPA_Ratio_Pct,
  India_Bank_NIM_Pct,
  India_Bank_ROA_Pct,
  Shock_Regime,
  Shock_Intensity
FROM
  workspace.banknifty_macro.bronze_banknifty_macro
WHERE
  Date IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY
  Date

datasets.name: scenario_results
queryLines:
SELECT
  scenario_name,
  preset,
  Brent_USD_bbl,
  USDINR,
  India_System_Liquidity_INR_Trn,
  India_Real_GDP_YoY_Pct,
  India_Bank_Credit_Growth_YoY_Pct,
  India_Policy_Rate_Pct,
  India_CPI_YoY_Pct,
  India_10Y_GSec_Yield_Pct,
  US10Y_Yield_Pct,
  India_Real_Rate,
  India_Term_Spread,
  India_Rate_Differential,
  predicted_log_return,
  predicted_simple_return,
  predicted_simple_return * 100 as predicted_return_pct,
  direction,
  signal_strength,
  scored_at
FROM
  workspace.banknifty_macro.gold_scenario_results
ORDER BY
  scored_at DESC
